mechanism: Tretinoin is highly teratogenic and medroxyprogesterone may have reduced contraceptive efficacy with retinoids, creating pregnancy risk; additionally, both drugs may increase hepatic metabolism through CYP3A4 induction.
action: Ensure reliable contraception is maintained; tretinoin requires strict pregnancy prevention protocols and medroxyprogesterone alone may be insufficient; consider additional contraceptive methods and monitor for breakthrough bleeding.
